product_metadata.title: Primula Luster Vacuum Sealed Stainless Steel Thermal Insulated Water Bottle Flask, 24 Cold, 8 Hours Hot, Reusable Thermos, Double Walled, 17 Ounce, Blush
features: VACUUM INSULATION TO KEEP DRINKS HOT OR COLD- The double wall vacuum sealed insulated design can keep drinks icy cold for up to 24 hours or hot for up to 8 hours.
DURABLY CONSTRUCTED PREMIUM WATER BOTTLE- The double wall stainless steel design keeps your drinks hot or cold without sweating or burning your hands.
LEAK-PROOF LID- The screw on lid is leak proof, so you can place this bottle in a gym bag, purse, in a car cup holder and more without worrying about your beverage leaking everywhere.
EASY TO CLEAN- This bottle is easy to clean with any bottle brush because of the wide mouth top. Get in hard to reach areas in a cinch!

HEALTHY AND - The Luster water bottle is made without BPA and is constructed of high quality stainless steel so you can enjoy your beverages in a healthy way without flavors transferring from the bottle into your drink.
description: Keep your hot or cold beverages at the perfect temperature all day long with this 17 ounce double wall bottle. The lid features a soft touch accent on the lid so you can easily get a grip while unscrewing the top. The screw top lid is also leak proof, so you can throw this bottle in your purse or gym bag without worrying about it spilling all over. This water bottle will fit in standard cup holders in the car, gym equipment, bottle holders in backpacks and more. This bottle is perfect for water, coffee, tea, and more and will keep your hot beverages hot for up to 8 hours and will keep your cold beverages cold for up to 24 hours.
